name: Lumière commercial public film projection
description: The Lumière enterprise projected moving photographic films to a paying Paris audience, following earlier demonstrations.

date.label: 28 December 1895
date.basis: Institut Lumière identifies the date of its first commercial presentation.

events.statement: The Lumière enterprise held a commercial film projection in Paris.
events.scope: This documents one commercial presentation and does not claim the world’s first cinema or the invention of projection; the institution’s history is not an independently inspected box-office ledger.
events.caveats: This documents one commercial presentation and does not claim the world’s first cinema or the invention of projection; the institution’s history is not an independently inspected box-office ledger.

evidence.supports: The Lumière enterprise held a commercial film projection in Paris.
Identifies the paying screening on 28 December 1895 at the Grand Café in Paris.
